items.prompt: A two-octet length header declares payload length 9 under this toy maximum of 8. What should the parser do?

options.text: Wait for an unlimited body before deciding
options.why: Rejecting the header first avoids trusting the oversized length.

options.text: Treat it as a valid empty frame
options.why: Nine and zero have different encodings.

options.text: Reject the frame under the declared bound
options.why: The accepted range is 0..8 payload octets.

options.text: Silently discard one byte to guess a new header
options.why: That invents an unapproved resynchronization policy.

items.explanation: Check length before accumulating its body. Error/recovery policy is part of the parser contract.
